storage_instruction: Store completed, unredacted evidence outside the public distribution.

scenarios.name: Day 1 meeting prep
scenarios.pass_rule: Explicit allowed intake; useful sourced context; visible unknown; zero unsupported consequential claims; concrete meeting action changed or confirmed.

scenarios.name: Cross-session correction retrieval
scenarios.pass_rule: Fresh process returns corrected truth, stale truth is not current, and provenance is visible.

scenarios.name: Backup and recovery
scenarios.pass_rule: No live-lock copy; checksums pass; isolated restore; doctor and two retrievals pass; exported config restores no credentials.

scenarios.name: Day 7 action or judgment change
scenarios.pass_rule: At least seven days elapsed; both periods have retrievable evidence; concrete change or evidence-backed hold is recorded.
